kuza-cave.hook: A culture centre around a cenote-like cave in Jambiani, with a daily 11:30 Swahili cooking lesson.
kuza-cave.why: Kuza Cave is a collapsed limestone chamber in Jambiani with a pool of clear groundwater at the bottom, closer to a Yucatan cenote than a show cave, and it is managed with the traditional owners in Kibigija Village. Around it runs a culture centre: a Swahili cooking lesson every day at 11:30 for US$30, two hours that end with eating what you cooked.
facts: Kuza Cave is a collapsed circular cave chamber with a groundwater pool, compared to a Yucatan cenote (Showcaves.com).
Managed in partnership with the traditional owners in Kibigija Village, at the first turn-off into Jambiani (kuzacave.com via search).
